title: A Compute Graph Simulation and Implementation Framework Targeting AMD Versal AI Engines
problem: Developing AI Engine (AIE) applications for AMD Versal requires separate host/accelerator codebases using AMD Vitis; this complicates development and integration with existing C++ code.
motivation: Unified C++ development would improve productivity; need to bridge C++ ecosystem with AIE dataflow graph compilation without Vitis's manual separation.
method: The framework provides a C++ library for simulating the compute graph (the sequence of operations performed on hardware) and an automatic code translator that converts your C++ code into AMD's AIE format. You write your application in standard C++, and the translator automatically generates the host and accelerator code, eliminating the need to manually maintain separate codebases.
key_novelty: The framework automatically translates a single C++ program into separate host and accelerator components using compile-time code execution, eliminating manual code separation.
contributions: C++ compute graph simulation library for AIE
Performance comparable to hand-optimized Vitis code
hardware_target: AMD Versal SoCs with AI Engines
primary_theme: Unified C++ framework for AMD Versal AI Engine development
